frame_range_convention: frame keys span exactly [1, n]; every action has frame_start=1 and frame_end=n
conventions: the character faces -Y; +yaw turns right, +pitch looks up
frame keys span exactly [1, n]; duration_seconds = n / 30
loop flags are manifest-only: Blender 5.1 Action.use_cyclic exists but does not wrap fcurve evaluation, so no CYCLES fcurve modifiers are added anywhere

locomotion clips are treadmill-authored: the stance foot moves backward relative to the body at the nominal apparent speed, so a controller moving the capsule at the nominal speed keeps the world feet planted
dash_* are root-motion clips: the root bone carries a linear 2.0 m translation along the dash direction; the controller/capsule must track the root bone and the mesh must not drift away from it
blink_out/blink_in bake no actor travel; the teleport/arrive events are pose markers only
layers: full_body (whole-body clip), upper_body (reusable upper-body layer over a locomotion/idle base), additive_upper (hit reactions authored over the neutral combat reference)
face props not driven by a clip hold their previous value within the clip; every clip starts from zeroed (neutral) face props

lip_sync.method: espeak-ng TTS phoneme timing (dialogue_alignment.json) drives the rig_ops.VISEMES shape-key presets; visemes crossfade linearly at entry boundaries with a subtle continuous jaw flutter; authored blinks, clause-indexed gaze and hand gestures ride the clause timeline

export.status: planned: tools/export_and_bake.py bakes each action to export/animations/<id>.fbx (take <id>) and imports it as an Unreal AnimSequence
export.face_actions: each <id>_face shape-key action exports with the same take (blend-shape track)
